title: Edge CDN WAF DDoS Mitigation Triggered

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `aws:cloudwatch` events matching `*` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.15.7 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudwatch` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

description: Monitors edge/CDN/WAF telemetry: ddos mitigation triggered. This UC monitors `aws:cloudwatch` for edge cdn waf ddos mitigation triggered and surfaces events for SOC triage, change review, and compliance evidence.
value: DDoS mitigation indicates active attack. Detecting edge cdn waf ddos mitigation triggered early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud edge logs via provider TA with the modular input for `aws:cloudwatch`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.15.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `metric_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudwatch.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch"
| table _time metric_name namespace unit average maximum
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.15.7_edge_cdn_waf_ddos_mitiga_7"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudwatch` in `index=aws` to detect edge cdn waf ddos mitigation triggered. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Amazon CloudWatch console Metrics for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `metric_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_15_7_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud edge logs via provider TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of edge cdn waf ddos mitigation triggered so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
